$comment: Canonical realm ids across the history checkpoints. Each continuing state has one id: the map nation id (tools/mapgen/nations-1444.json) when the state or its continuation is on the map, else the catalogue id, else a new id. aliases are the ids merged into it; years are the checkpoints that list it. Checked by check_ids.py.

realms.name: Burgundian State / Habsburg Netherlands
realms.note: Map id; the Burgundian Netherlands continue as the Habsburg/Spanish and Austrian Netherlands until 1795.

realms.name: Hafsid Tunis / Regency of Tunis
realms.note: Map id; the Hafsid state continued as the Ottoman regency and beylik.

realms.name: Margraviate of Meissen and Landgraviate of Thuringia (Wettin)
Duchy of Bavaria (Upper and Lower Bavaria-Landshut)
Albania (Thopia 1378; League of Lezhë 1444; principality 1914)
realms.note: The id is reused for three separate states, each with its own formed/ended break.

realms.name: Savoy / Sardinia / Italy
realms.note: Map id; the Kingdom of Sardinia became the Kingdom of Italy in 1861 (legal continuation).

realms.name: Comtat Venaissin / Avignon obedience
realms.note: The papal enclave at Avignon; seat of the Avignon obedience, counted as ended by 1420.

realms.name: Golden Horde / Great Horde
realms.note: One id for the Golden Horde and its central rump; the 1438–1466 splits are recorded as Kazan, Crimea, Nogai, the Uzbeks and Astrakhan forming. Ends 1502.

realms.name: Yemen (Rasulid, Tahirid, Zaydi imamate)
realms.note: Map id; the highland Zaydi imamate is treated as the continuing Yemeni state.

realms.name: Tibet (Phagmodrupa; Ganden Phodrang from 1815)
realms.note: Phagmodrupa to c.1618 (ended by 1715); the id is reused for the Ganden Phodrang, formed again in 1815.

realms.name: Lan Xang / Luang Prabang
realms.note: Luang Prabang keeps the Lan Xang id as the royal line that becomes the Kingdom of Laos; Vientiane and Champasak form at the 1707–1713 split.

realms.name: Mayapan league / Maní (Xiu)
realms.note: Map id; the League of Mayapan (to c.1441) and its successor Maní (Xiu) are treated as one line. Ends with the Spanish conquest (1542).

realms.name: Multan (Khizr Khan 1405; Langah sultanate 1444–1500)
realms.note: The id is reused for two separate states, each with its own formed/ended break.

realms.name: Ireland (Gaelic lordships; Kingdom of Ireland 1542–1800)
realms.note: The id follows the island's polity; ended with the 1801 Union.

realms.name: Uzbek Khanate / Bukhara
realms.note: Abu'l-Khayr's khanate, the Shaybanids and the Khanate/Emirate of Bukhara treated as one continuing state.

realms.name: Jianzhou Jurchens / Later Jin / Qing
realms.note: Map id; Nurhaci's Jianzhou state continued as Later Jin (1616) and Qing (1636). The Republic of China (1912) is a separate id.

realms.name: Dughlat realm of Kashgar and Yarkand
Safavid, Afsharid, Zand and Qajar Iran
realms.note: Safavid order (1500) and Iran to 1914 under one id.

realms.name: United Provinces / Kingdom of the Netherlands
realms.note: Dutch Republic and the post-1813 kingdom treated as one state.

realms.name: Kingdom of Vientiane
realms.note: In 1815 this file used lan_xang for Vientiane; renamed for that year only.

realms.name: Hesse-Darmstadt / Grand Duchy of Hesse
realms.note: In 1914 this file used hesse for the Grand Duchy of Hesse; renamed for that year only.

realms.name: United Provinces of the Río de la Plata / Argentina
Republic of the United States of Brazil
